GOAL: establish what the shared observed evidence actually says about where the Stage-3 recall loss sits, before placing any proposal.

const rec2 = await tools.progress.append_progress({content: `STAGE: scope check and pairwise coupling comparison.
GOAL: decide, for each proposal, whether the behaviour term and the curved operation sit in one connected pathway, and whether the three switches exist.
READ: proposal CHANGE/SPECIFICATION blocks and E12/E13 for each.
OBSERVED:
- HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR: score is q_behaviour(k') * exp(-d_kappa(v_i, c_k)), with v_i a gyromidpoint of the item and its behavioural neighbours; behaviour-off sets q to uniform and drops the gyromidpoint, geometry-off replaces d_kappa with Euclidean. Levels 1..L-1 bit-identical. Zero added training cost.
- ADM-GEO-RQ: curved dP is the assignment metric inside the RQ argmin at every level every step, and created-removed disjoint counts plus the travel budget gap <= allowance sit in the same inequality. Kernel and allowance are measured at epoch 0; K=1 fixed; risk (3) explicitly names the geometry-off/both-on comparison. Strongest in-training coupling of the five, and the only in-training proposal reaching the deepest level.
- HEXSWAP-SID: move set is generated by Lorentz-nearest-codeword vs Euclidean-assignment disagreement, so geometry-off empties the candidate set rather than merely reweighting it; behaviour log-ratio + curvature-scaled bisector margin gate acceptance; K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) is derived. Strong coupling but level-1 only, and it runs once after epoch 3000.
- TAUSWAP: curved distance to hyperbolic Frechet cell means forms the swap gain, behaviour supplies candidates and the exact integer Delta-D/Delta-R predicate; removing geometry changes the gain ranking but the accept decision is still driven by the behaviour counts, so coupling is moderate. Level-1 only, post-hoc.
- GROMOVSWAP: candidates, theta, and the dS/dD objective are all behaviour-derived; the Poincare/Gromov delta_hat certificate is only an eligibility gate on swaps already chosen by behaviour. Of the five this is the weakest coupling (geometry can only veto; it never generates or scores a move), it is level-1 only, and it perturbs the partition every epoch for 2700 epochs, which the proposal itself flags as a reconstruction-damage risk.
REASONING: E6/E7 make level-1-only repair structurally mis-aimed; among the L1 proposals, order by how load-bearing the curved computation is (HEXSWAP generates the move set > TAUSWAP scores the gain > GROMOVSWAP only certifies). Between the two leaf-reaching proposals, HYP-CERT leaves the perfectly-predicted prefix untouched and edits exactly the token holding all the NLL, while ADM-GEO is stronger in-training but re-solves the assignment metric that the motivation admits failed in earlier curved-assignment rounds and whose dX<=0 veto is trivially satisfied by staying put.
OPEN: emit the five-line ranking.`}); return {rec1, rec2};

STAGE: complete answer (final record).
The five-line ranking below is the deliverable. Basis: shared observed evidence E6 (gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068, best recall 0.06363 under the 0.065 target) and E7 (T1/T2/T3 NLL 0.00 vs T4 9.03) localise the loss at the deepest SID token; E8 (256-way L1 co-location 0.0822) and E11 (same-first-prefix 0.0907 vs 0.067 null) show the level-1 cell carries little behavioural signal, so level-1-only repair is mis-aimed. Ordering within the proposals also uses the E12/E13 coupling direction (HEXSWAP generates its move set from the curved metric; TAUSWAP uses curvature only as a gain; GROMOVSWAP uses it only as a veto).

RANK: HYP-CERT-LEAFREPAIR | position=1 | reason=E6/E7 show the prefix is already fully alive (gold prefix depth 1/2/3 = 1.000/1.000/1.000, T1-T3 NLL 0.00) and all loss is the deepest token (T4 NLL 9.03, depth-4 survival 0.068); this is the only proposal that leaves levels 1..L-1 bit-identical and repairs exactly that token through a behaviour-agreement x Poincare-distance score, so the curved term and the behaviour term sit in one scoring product.
RANK: ADM-GEO-RQ | position=2 | reason=E12/E13 put curved dP inside the RQ argmin at every level and every Stage-2 step with the exact behaviour veto created-removed and the travel budget in the same inequality, so it is the only in-training proposal that also reaches the deepest level where E7 localises the loss; held below first place because E6 shows the Euclidean/curved assignment variants l1_br_euclid/l1_only/resample already cluster at 0.06207/0.06233/0.06363, and the dX<=0 veto is trivially met by not moving.
RANK: HEXSWAP-SID | position=3 | reason=level-1 only, which E6's 100%-alive depth-1 prefix and E7's zero T1 NLL make the wrong target, but among the L1 repairs its coupling is the most load-bearing: the move set is defined by Lorentz-nearest-codeword vs Euclidean-assignment disagreement, so geometry-off empties the candidate set rather than decorating it, and K=1/(4 delta_hat^2) is measured rather than tuned.
RANK: TAUSWAP-POINCARE-EXCHANGE | position=4 | reason=also level-1 only and thus aimed away from the E7 T4 bottleneck; Poincare distance to the Frechet cell means enters only as the swap gain while the exact integer Delta-D/Delta-R behaviour counts drive the accept decision, and the proposal itself concedes the curved and Euclidean gains may rank swaps almost identically near the ball origin, so the geometry is the least likely of the moderate-coupling proposals to be demonstrably necessary.
RANK: GROMOVSWAP-L1-RQ | position=5 | reason=of the five it has the weakest coupling under condition 3: candidates, theta and the monotone split/disjoint objective are behaviour-derived and the Gromov delta_hat certificate can only veto an already-chosen swap, so it neither generates nor scores the move, and it is level-1 only against E6/E7 while perturbing the partition every epoch for 2700 epochs, a reconstruction-damage risk the proposal admits.
